Commentary.Commentary: End of this game which means end of the ODI series. India win yet another series and they would now be trying to eyeing the Test series. For West Indies, it is their last chance to win a trophy. It is a two-game Test series and the first one begins at 22nd August at 0930 local (1330 GMT). Till then, take care and goodbye!

Indian skipper, Man of the Match and Man of the Series, Virat Kohli, says the last couple of games have presented a challenge. He though feels Iyer was brilliant in this game, he was the game-changer and Iyer never let pressure build on him. Further adds he wants his teammates to take responsibility and Iyer is really doing well, not only in this game, but in the last one too, reckoning he is a very talented youngster. Says the finger is fine for now, he does not think it is broken and he should be okay for the first Test. Admits they were a bit nervous when the rain came as West Indies played really well initially but they came back strong after the break and the bowlers did a very good job. Ends by saying they are confident heading into the Test series and are looking forward to it.

West Indies skipper, Jason Holder, says the rain break changed the course of the game as it was not easy to start again on this surface but feels that the batters though still did a good job. He felt they were always in the game, credits the Indian players for the way they played but admits they too were not good enough with the ball. Further adds they have let themselves down a lot in the recent past and they need to learn more and understand a lot more and somehow cross the hurdles. States the team is a work in progress, they need to take a closer look at their eleven and hope they learn quickly. Ends by saying they need to turn things around in the red-ball format now.

Earlier in the day, the Windies after electing to bat, got off to an absolute flier. However, the rain break probably played against them as after that they struggled to score. They still would have been happy at the halfway mark as they had a score which was termed to be above par on this surface but India chased it down quite easily.

The Windies bowling was just not upto the mark! They were too short and a little wayward too. Chase and Allen did keep it tight for a while. The latter was the pick of the bowlers. But they had no answers once Iyer stepped on the gas. The pacers needed to step up but they could neither pick up wickets nor stem the flow of runs.

Chasing something more than a run-a-ball, the Indian openers came out all guns blazing. They started to score freely but Rohit was then run out. Dhawan and Kohli though continued the counter-attack and brought things back on track with a 66-run stand. However, Pant and Dhawan fell in quick succession and India at that time were in a spot of bother but Iyer with his captain, played himself in and once he got his eye in, hit the bowlers at will. He added a 120-run stand with Kohli with him scoring a half ton. He was the aggressor in that stand and scored more runs than Kohli in it. His knock also did not let any pressure build on Kohli. Iyer though will be disappointed he did not stay there till the end but Kohli ensured he was the one who hit the winning runs bringing up his ton in the process. All-in-all an excellent chase by the Indians.

255 a tough chase on this tacky wicket? Think twice! India have done this quite easily. Heroes for them - their skipper, run-machine, chase-master - call him what you want as you are going to fall short of superlatives for Virat Kohli. And the other, a youngster, one who is looking to make a name for himself, maybe someone who could fill that no. 4 spot, Shreyas Iyer. It is their partnership which has given India not only a victory in this game but also the series 2-0.
FOUR! Kohli finishes it off in style! A freebie by Brathwaite, it is on the pads, Kohli flicks it fine on the leg side and a boundary results. INDIA WIN BY 6 WICKETS (DLS METHOD)!
FOUR! Three needed now! Shorter and on middle, Kohli pulls it through mid-wicket and the ball races away to the fence.
Shorter and outside off, this is slapped through point for one.
Carlos Brathwaite is back into the attack.
This is on the pads, it is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Runs needed in single digits now! This is fuller on the pads, Jadhav works it through square leg. Pooran in the deep runs to his left, dives and pushes it back in. Two taken.
Shorter and on middle, Kohli guides it to point for one.
Very full and on off, this is hit down to long on for one.
Shorter and on off, Kohli works it through mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Class, pure class! No need to run for those. Welcomes his opposite number with a boundary. Holder goes full and around off, Kohli creams it through covers and the ball races away to the fence.
Jason Holder is back!

FOUR! Jadhav is playing a gem here. He is on 14 from 8 balls. Nice touch this. It is short and outside off, Kedar waits for it, uses the pace of the bowler and guides it past point for a boundary. 14 from the over, probably the one which kills the game completely. 18 needed in 24.

100 for Virat Kohli. Century no. 43 and two in two games in this series. Once again, the master of run chases rises to the occasion. A true leader, a brilliant batter. He works this full ball on middle towards long on to get to that milestone. Takes the helmet off and soaks in the applause. The best in this format.
FOUR! Very nicely played! Kohli moves onto 99. This is just outside off, Kohli opens the face of the bat at the very end and guides it past short third man for a boundary.
On off, this is pushed to covers.
Top edge and FOUR! Short and on middle, Kohli looks to pull but does not get on top of the bounce, it goes off the top edge and to the fine leg region for a boundary.
On off, this is pushed through covers for one.
On middle, Kohli works it to square leg.
Floats it up on middle, Kohli hits it back to the bowler.
Now smartly works it through mid-wicket for one.
SIX! Well, if that single would have been stopped, this six might not have been hit. Kedar comes on strike, dances down the track and hits it with the turn over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
On middle, Kohli works it through square leg for an easy one. Maybe they could have had square leg in the ring and saved that single.
Flatter and outside off, this is guided towards backward point for one.
Shorter and on middle, Jadhav pulls it over mid-wicket for one. Excellent over by Roach. Three runs and a wicket. 41 in 36 needed.
A yorker on middle, KJ jams it out on the leg side.
Shorter and on middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
Leading edge but safe! On off, Kohli looks to work it on the leg side but closes the face of the bat early. A leading edge is induced which goes over the bowler and down to long off for one.
Kedar Jadhav is the new man in.

OUT! Iyer has thrown it away in the attempt to end it early! He though has done his job. End of a brilliant innings by the young man. Came in at a tough time but has taken India to the brink of victory along with his captain. He though will be disappointed that he is not there till the end. Roach bowls this fuller and on off, it sticks in the surface. Iyer does not time his loft and it goes straight to Holder at long off. End of a match-winning 120-run stand. West Indies have a sniff here.
Length ball just outside off, Kohli drives it towards long on for one.
Powerplay 3 is on now. Maximum of 5 fielders allowed outside the circle till the end of the game.
SIX! Iyer wants to end this early! That made a cracking sound of the bat. Floats it up on middle, Iyer brings the slog sweep out and it goes over the mid-wicket fence.
Fires it on the pads, Iyer swings but misses.
Flatter and on off, Kohli goes back and hits it towards deep mid-wicket for one.
Loopy ball on off, this is hit back to the bowler.
Floats it up on off, Kohli flicks it to mid-wicket.
This is on middle, Kohli works it with the turn to square leg.
Roston Chase is back into the attack.
Another one on a length and around off, Kohli pushes it to covers for one.
On off, this is defended.
This is on the pads, Iyer works it through mid-wicket for one.
Length ball on off pole, Kohli defends it towards the point region for one.
The physio is out to have a look! HE has the magic spray out but Kohli looks in serious pain here. Like always, the magic spray does its job and Kohli is fine to continue.

Ouch! That must have stung and Kohli is in pain, in real pain. That took off from nowhere. This is on a length and around off, it takes off after pitching. Kohli looks to defend but the ball hits the glove and lobs towards short third man. Kohli immediately takes the glove off and signals the physio to rush out.
Down the leg side, Kohli looks to flick but misses. Wided.
Slower short ball outside off, Iyer is a touch early in his shot and hence, it goes through covers for one. 200 up for India.
Kemar Roach is back!
Fuller and on off, Iyer jams it out through covers and takes one. 9 from the over. 56 needed in 54.
The batsman has pushed it to the cover region. They manage to come back for the second.
Shorter in length and outside off, this is slapped through covers for one.
Shorter on off, Kohli pushes it to covers.
On off, Iyer plays it late and towards third man for one.

Fifty for Iyer! He gets there in style. What an innings this is. Talk about a knock full of character. Talk about grabbing the opportunity with both hands. He came in when India were in trouble and has rose to the occasion. Lovely. His 4th in ODIs and consecutive ones. He would love to stay there till the end though. He gets there by guiding this short ball outside off through backward point. He just used the pace of the bowler there. Also, the 100-run stand is up. This has been a partnership of high quality. They have taken India to the brink of victory. Not done yet.

FOUR! In the gap and a boundary! And once again we see the last ball spoils the over. Brathwaite bangs it short. Kohli pulls, it is not controlled but in the gap in the square leg region and it races away.
Back of a length and on off, Iyer whips it through mid-wicket for one. 48 he moves onto.
This is angled into the batter, Kohli works it towards mid-wicket and takes the first one quickly but has to settle for that.
Good length on off, Iyer pushes it through covers for one.
A low full toss on off, Kohli pushes it to mid off.
Good fielding! Fuller and on middle, Kohli whips it through mid-wicket. Lewis in the deep runs to his left, dives and pushes it back in. Two taken.
Slower one again outside off, Iyer drives it square on the off side. A dot to end.
This is angled into the batter, Kohli looks to fend it but it goes off the inner half towards mid-wicket for one.
Shorter in length again and on off, Iyer pushes it through covers and gets to the other end.
Back of a length on off, Kohli guides it through covers for another one.
Drags his length back outside off, Kohli looks to guide it but misses. A dot, West Indies need a lot more dots.

FOUR! India are cruising along at the moment now. A boundary to end the last over and one to begin this. Kohli comes down the track and creams it through covers. He makes it into a full toss and bags a boundary.
Keemo Paul is back on now!

SIX! Shot of the game for me so far! That is beautiful, just beautiful. On the fuller side and around off, Iyer stretches his arms and lofts it over the long on fence. 12 from the over. 82 needed in 72. Run rate below 7 needed now.
Another slower one, Kohli guides it through point and gets to the other end.
This is on middle, it is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Slower one on off, Kohli works it on the leg side for one.
Almost plays it on! Shorter and slower on off, Kohli is early in the pull, he gets an inside edge which goes close past the leg pole and to the keeper.
Another wide! This is down the leg side again, Kohli tries to flick but misses. Wided again.
On off, Iyer guides it towards point for one.
Down the leg side, Iyer looks to flick but misses. Wided.

FOUR! Deft now! This is top class batting! Slightly short and outside off, Kohli guides it past backward point. Allen in the deep runs to his left, dives and tries to push it back in but he seems to have made contact with the ropes as he tries to do so. The umpire checks upstairs and replays show that he has. Boundary signaled. FA is in some pain though.
FOUR! That is some shot, some shot. Outrageous. Genius is the right word. Kohli makes room and Holder bowls it full on the middle. He still manages to loft it over covers for a boundary.
Good length on off, Iyer drops it on the off side for one.
A low full toss on the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
In the air but safe! Shorter and on middle, it gets big on the batter. Kohli gets a top edge as he tries to pull. It goes towards deep mid-wicket for two.
Shorter and outside off, Kohli looks to guide it but misses.
Jason Holder brings himself back on.

FOUR! Misfield and a boundary! That was smashed, yes, but should have been stopped. Holder is the culprit. Fuller and on off, Iyer hits it hard towards cover. Holder lets it through and the ball races away. The last ball spoils the over. 7 from the over. 106 needed in 84. India on top now.
Shorter and on middle, Kohli hits it down to long on for one.
Powerfully struck but for no runs. Fuller and on off, Kohli smashes it but to mid off. Two dots in a row.
Fuller and on off, it is driven to covers.
Shorter and outside off, this is guided through point for one.
Shorter in length, Kohli comes down the track and looks to pull but mistimes it through mid-wicket for one.
Carlos Brathwaite is on!
Flatter and outside off, Kohli plays it late towards short third man for one.
Driven through mid off by the batsman for no runs.
Good batting! Need not do anything silly now so he just guides it towards short third man for one.

SIX! Three sixes for Iyer in the last 4 balls he has faced. This time Roston chase is at the receiving end. It is on the pads, Iyer brings the slog sweep out. Connects well and it goes over the square leg fence.
On middle, this is hit to mid-wicket.
Shorter and outside off, Kohli guides it through covers for one.
SIX! What a shot by Iyer! He is looking to get a move on here. Short of a length ball on off, Iyer goes on the back foot and heaves it over mid-wicket for a biggie. 122 in 96 needed.
SIX! Iyer has picked the bones out of that one! What a shot. Excellent use of the feet, gets to the pitch of the ball and tonks it over the long off fence for a huge one.

Good try! This is floated up on middle, Kohli looks to go inside out once again but it goes off the inner half back towards the bowler who  dives to his right, stops it and as he falls, tries to flick it on the stumps at his end. Misses and a single is taken. Could have been close had he hit. Lovely athleticism.
Good running! This is floated up on off, Kohli lofts it over covers and takes two.
Another dot as Kohli once again strokes it to covers.
Floats it up on off, Kohli strokes it to covers.
BEATEN! This is fired outside, Iyer looks to hit it through the off side but misses.

Fuller and on off, Kohli eases it to long on for one. Fifty for Kohli. HIs 55th in ODIs. He continues his good form vs West Indies. Once again the skipper is leading from the front. Needs to keep going though.
FOUR! Poor ball and put away. A rare one by Chase. Short and outside off, Kohli goes back and punches it through covers. Lewis in the deep runs to his right, dives but fails to stop it.
Flatter and on off, Kohli works it to square leg.
Iyer comes down the track but does not get to the pitch of the ball, he adjusts and works it through square leg for one.
Flatter and on off, Kohli pushes it down to long on for one.

DRINKS! So, India now need 144 off 18 overs to get across the line as the skipper Virat Kohli and Shreyas Iyer are out in the middle. The batting coming in next looks a bit thin and it is very important for India that these two have a strong partnership here.
Two to end a good over for India! Shorter and outside off, Iyer goes back and cuts it uppishly but wide of point for two.
Gives it air, Iyer strokes it to covers.
Shorter and around off, Kohli pushes it through covers for one.
Good batting! Got a boundary on the last ball and now hits it down to long off for one.
FOUR! Releases some pressure which was building! This is slightly shorter and outside off, Iyer plays it very late and gets it past point for a boundary.
This is fired on the stumps, Iyer keeps it out.
A single to end as Iyer works it through mid-wicket.
Flatter and on off, Iyer pushes it down to long on for one.
Close! This is outside off and it turns back in. Kohli goes back and plays it off the off stump towards short third man.
Shortish and outside off, Kohli pulls but finds mid-wicket.
On the pads, this is worked fine on the leg side for two. 100 up for India.
Slightly shorter and outside, Iyer slaps it through covers for one.
On the stumps, this is kept out. 20 overs left, 157 more needed.
A nice shot but for no runs! Floats it up on off, Kohli hits it to covers.
Just the single! Shorter and outside off, Iyer goes back and slaps it through covers for one.
On off, Iyer pushes it towards point. He wants a run but is sent back.
Outside off and turning away. Iyer waits for it and guides it to short third man.
Flatter and on middle, this is kept out.
A dot to end as Kohli works it with the turn to the man at mid-wicket.
One more single as Iyer hits it down to long on.
This is on the pads, Kohli whips it through mid-wicket for one.
Loopy ball on off, Iyer is off the mark as he eases it down to long on for one.
On off, this is defended.
Another single as Kohli works it through mid-wicket for one.
A single to end as this is hit through covers. A game-changing over this, two wickets and two runs.
Almost another one! This is shorter and outside off, Kohli looks to cut but ends up chopping it.
Shreyas Iyer is the one who replaces Pant.

OUT! This is just unbelievable! Pant has once again thrown it away and not for the first time. India now in big trouble here. What was he trying to do here! The first ball he faces he comes down the track and looks to whip it over the leg side. The ball goes on with the angle and hence a leading edge which goes high up in the air. Paul takes another catch, this time by backtracking. Kohli has a disappointed look on his face and rightly so. A first-baller for Pant.
Floats it up on off, this is hit through covers for one.
Rishabh Pant is the new man in for the Men In Blue.

OUT! In the air... Keemo Paul does not look very confident under it, he though takes it in the end. A good, good catch and the pressure built by West Indies in the last few overs has paid off. Dhawan looks to take on the left-arm spinner as he comes down the track. Tries to go over the mid off fielder but only manages to hit it high up in the air as he does not get to the pitch of the ball. Paul initially backtracks but then turns and runs backwards, takes a nice catch. A threatening stand comes to an end. West Indies back in the game. 164 needed in 136.
One more dot as Dhawan comes down the track and hits it hard to mid off.
Good fielding! Saves a run. This is flatter and on off, Kohli hits it towards mid on. Mid-wicket runs across, dives and stops it. Just the two from the over. Back-to-back good overs for West Indies.
Fuller and on the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
Shorter and outside off, Dhawan slaps it but straight to covers.
This is fired on the pads, Dhawan looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads.
Flatter and on middle. this is worked through square leg for one. It was actually a misfield which enabled the run.
OHHH! This is floated up on off, it stays a touch low and also turns back in. It goes off the toe-end of Kohli's bat and to mid-wicket.
Roston Chase is on now! Spin from both ends then.
This is fired on the pads, Kohli works it through mid-wicket and gets to the other end. 6 from the over, West Indies need a few more tight overs like these.
Loopy ball on off, Kohli hits it back to the bowler.
Two now! This is flatter and on the pads, Kohli works it through square leg and takes two.
On the pads, Dhawan looks to flick but misses. The ball hits the pads and rolls on the leg side. A leg bye taken.
Flatter and on off, Kohli goes back and pushes it through covers for one.
On off, Dhawan plays it late and towards short third man for one.
172 needed now in 150. Shorter and outside off, this is guided through point for one.
FOUR! Up and over! Fuller and on off, Dhawan waits for the slower one to come to him and then he lofts it over mid off for a boundary. 173 needed in 151.
Shorter and on middle, Kohli stands tall and nudges it around the corner for one.
This is angled into the pads, Dhawan looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. The ball rolls on the off side. A leg bye taken.
Around off, Dhawan pushes it to covers. Need a few more dots to build the pressure here.
WIDE! Shorter and down the leg side, Dhawan looks to pull but misses. Wided.

Shorter and outside off, Kohli hits it through covers for one. 50-run stand up. They are going along nicely especially after the loss of Rohit. They hold the key as the batters coming in do not have a lot of experience.
A single to finish another productive over for India. This is on off, Kohli guides it to short third man for one.
FOUR! Spoils the over completely. A poor ball this, short and outside off, Kohli goes back and cuts it through point. No chance for the fielder in the deep.
On middle, this is defended.
Floats it on off, Dhawan plays it with an opened face of the bat and guides it towards third man for one.
Flatter and on middle, Dhawan works it through mid-wicket for two.
That stayed low! Flatter and on middle, the ball stays low. Kohli manages to pull it through mid-wicket for one.
Fabian Allen into the attack now.
Dhawan drives this through the covers. The fielder there stops it and no runs taken.
Shorter and outside off, Dhawan cuts but to point.
Lovely timing but just for one. Slower one on off, Kohli strokes it through covers for one.
Slower one on middle, Kohli works it to mid-wicket after taking a few steps down the track.
WIDE! Dhawan though will feel he misses out there. It is a short slower one down the leg side. Dhawan looks to pull but misses. Hope does not collect it cleanly and a run is taken.
Shorter in length again and outside off, the batter looks to cut but misses.
FOUR! Edgy boundary! Now everything is going India's way. This is short and outside off, Dhawan throws the kitchen sink at it. It goes off the outside edge and over the keeper's hand for a boundary.
A good nut to end but a good over for India. This is on a length and around off, it takes off after pitching. Kohli looks to defend but it hits the body of Kohli. 10 from the over.

FOUR! This shot had class written all over it. This is full and outside off, it is the slower one. Kohli waits for it and then creams it through covers for a boundary. Also, he beat two fielders there, one at short covers and the other at normal covers.
Good fielding! The skipper leads by example. This is on middle, Dhawan hits it hard towards mid on. Holder dives to his right and saves three for his side.
Mistimed! Dhawan is going too hard on the delivery. This is shorter and outside off, Dhawan throws his bat at it but does not find the middle.
Now sensibly follows the boundary with a single as he guides it towards point.

FOUR! Up and over! His one hand did come off of the handle but he was in full control. This is on a length and around off, Kohli lofts it over the mid off fielder for a boundary. 50 up for India and it has come up in quick time.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman. They pick up a single.

DROPPED! Shai Hope has dropped a dolly here and it is King Kohli who survives. Kohli charges down the track to this length ball as he tries to flick it towards mid-wicket. However, he just manages to get an inside edge on it and the ball carries to Hope but he drops one. The West Indies players are frustrated that they have missed the big fish here. A run is also added to the total.

Lobbed into the air but the ball falls safely. Full ball on the pads of Kohli, he tries to flick it but gets a thick edge on it as the ball balloons towards the empty mid-wicket region. The batters take a couple.
Fuller ball on off, Dhawan drives it towards mid off and takes a single.
Wide! Way outside off, wide signalled by the umpire as Dhawan leaves it.
Length ball on the hips of Kohli, he tries to flick again but misses to get hit on the pads. The Windies appeal but the umpire is unmoved. The batters cross and take a leg bye.
Wide! Full ball on the leg side. Kohli tries to flick it but misses. Wide signalled.
Keemo Paul is on now!
A misfield and a run! This is shorter and on off, Kohli pushes it towards cover. The fielder fumbles and a run is taken.
Dhawan comes down the track and looks to go big, it goes off the inner half through square leg for one.
This is fuller and on middle, Kohli goes at it with hard hands, it goes off the inner half through square leg for one.
This is angled into the batter, Kohli works it to mid-wicket.
A couple now! This is fuller and outside off, Kolhi drives it uppishly and square on the off side. Takes two as there is a fielder in the deep.
Back of a length outside off, Dhawan looks to force it on the off side but gets an inside edge onto the pads. It rolls on the off side and a run is taken.
Length ball just outside off, Kohli plays it towards point and sets off for a single but Dhawan sends him back. No runs taken.
On the pads of Kohli, he defends it on the leg side.
FOUR! Innovation at its best. Short ball on the off side, Kohli bends his back and just upper cuts it over the slip fielder for a boundary.
On the legs of Dhawan again, he flicks it towards deep square leg and takes a single.
Fullish ball, it is hit towards deep point for a single. Holder is smart to place a fielder in that region as they know mid-wicket is his strength.
Length ball on the hips of Dhawan, it hits him and the ball rolls towards fine leg as they take a single.
A dot to end a successful over for West Indies. This is shorter and on off, Kohli stands tall and keeps it out.
Another risky run! This is a full toss on off, Dhawan strokes it towards mid off and takes off. The fielder there fumbles and makes the run easy for them.

OUT! He indeed is! A much-needed breakthrough for West Indies and it has come in the form of a run out. The last thing India wanted and it is the last way Rohit would have wanted to get out. There was a run to be honest. This is a shortish ball outside off, Dhawan guides it towards backward point. Rohit wants a run but seeing the diving stop of Allen, Dhawan sends him back. Rohit is almost halfway down the wicket. He now turns and tries to get back in. Allen picks the ball up and throws it to the bowler who collects it and dislodges the bails. The umpire takes it upstairs. Relays roll in and they show Rohit's dive does not save him. A big wicket for West Indies as Rohit was looking good in the few balls he faced. 230 more needed.
Is Rohit Sharma run out? West Indies are not that confident but he seems short.
Misses out there does Dhawan! This is shorter and outside off, he looks to guide it past short third man but ends up chopping it to the fielder.

FOUR! Another excellent shot this! Dhawan actually set himself up to go over the leg side as he shuffles right across. Roach bowls it short and wide outside off. Dhawan adjusts and slaps it through covers for a boundary.
On middle, Dhawan guides it to point.
Back of a length again on off, Dhawan pushes it towards cover for one. 11 from the second. India off to a flier.
Good running! Running between the wickets is equally important in this game. On off, Rohit drops it towards cover and takes off. The fielder fumbles and the run is made easier.
A single now! This is angled into the pads from around the wicket. Dhawan looks to flick but gets an inside edge onto the pads. It rolls on the leg side for one.
FOUR! Raining boundaries here from the Indian batters this time. To the right of mid off now. This is fuller and around off, Dhawan strokes it through wide mid off and the ball races away.

FOUR! Need not run for those. Straight as an arrow. This is a top shot. Not a lot wrong with the delivery. It is on a length and on middle, Dhawan pushes it through mid off and bags a boundary. Third already for India.
Good fielding! This is on a length and around off, Dhawan stands tall and strokes it towards cover. Lewis there dives to his left and saves two at least.
Jason Holder to bowl from the other end with the second new ball.
A dot to end the first over! 10 from it. Good one for India. Shorter on off, Rohit pushes it to covers.
Dhawan is off the mark now! This is on middle, Dhawan looks to flick but it goes off the inside edge, then onto the pads and on the leg side for one.
A single now! On the pads, Rohit works it through mid-wicket for one.
On a good length and outside off, this has been left alone.

FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! This one a touch edgy but Rohit won't care. This is outside off, Rohit looks to guide it down to third man but it goes off the outside edge, past the slip fielder and into the third man fence.

FOUR! What a start to the innings for India. What a shot to begin with. This is slightly short and outside off, Rohit needs no sighters. He lifts one leg up and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
We are back for the chase! The Indian openers, Shikhar Dhawan and Rohit Sharma are out in the middle. Kemar Roach to open the proceedings for the West Indies. Here we go...
